name: Ethical Research Writing in Automotive Engineering
description: Engineering ethics: introduction, code of ethics, confidentiality, conflict of interest, intellectual property, approach for ethical problems, role of professional bodies. Safety, responsibility and rights: risk assessment, risk benefit analysis, establishing safeguards, ethical obligations about facts and future risks, safety testing and standards, ethical approach for autonomous vehicle. Environmental issues: emission tests and clean air act, concept of NVH, waste disposal, reuse and second life assessment. Ethical research writing and presentation: scientific/technical writing tools; ethics of publication, plagiarism, attribution, copyrights, technical disclosure; journal paper, patent, research proposal and thesis writing, presenting the scientific data, use of AI/ML tools for ethical writing.
